name: Audacity
title: Audacity: free Adobe Audition alternative
hook: Adobe Audition charges you twenty three bucks a month to edit your audio. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Record, edit, and mix, all in one app.
features.say: Record your voice or music, then edit it across multiple tracks.
Polish it with effects like compressor, reverb and EQ. It even supports VST3 plugins.

caption:
Adobe Audition charges $22.99/month (billed yearly). Audacity records and edits your audio for free 🎙

✅ Record your voice or music and edit it across multiple tracks
✅ Built-in effects like compressor, reverb and EQ
✅ Supports VST3 plugins
✅ No subscription, no trial, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The download page offers the optional Muse Hub installer or a direct download, and audio.com cloud saving is optional too.
